If the amounts relate to an outstanding Director’s Loan Account (DLA), please confirm: 
	a. Over what period did the DLA accrue? 
	b. Did the director also receive wages in addition to the DLA? 
	c. Was the DLA the director's sole form of remuneration? 
	d. Was the DLA converted to dividends, and if so, was this an appropriate and reasonable method of remuneration? 
	e. If the DLA was instead paid as a salary, would it be considered unreasonable or excessive? 
	f. Has there been any communication with the director regarding the recovery of these funds?
Please provide details of the amount owed to HMRC, including the specific taxes it relates to, and the periods covered.

Provide a copy of HMRC's Proof of Debt, along with any other relevant documents in your possession related to the Crown debt (e.g., demand letters, Statement of Liabilities, Winding-up Petition, etc.).
Do the bank statements show payments made to HMRC in the final 12 months of trading? If so, how much?
Is there any evidence that HMRC was treated unfairly compared to other creditors? If so, please provide further details.
Was the company engaged in a Time to Pay agreement with HMRC? If so, please provide the relevant details.
Could you please provide a copy of the Aged Creditors Listing?
Please provide a detailed bank statement analysis showing payments made to HMRC, along with copies of the relevant bank statements for the last two years (If available).

Was there, or does there appear to have been, any reasonable prospect of this company being successful?
At what point does it appear the director knew, or should have known, that this company was insolvent?
Details of the coronavirus support scheme(s) received by the company, including the date and amount received.

If the company received a BBL, did it meet the criteria (see below)? 
	* The company was based in the UK, established, and operating before 1 March 2020. 
	* The company's trading was adversely impacted by the coronavirus. 
	* It had not applied for another BBL.

In making the BBL application, was the company's turnover for 2019 overstated by 25% or more? If so, please provide: 
	* Details of the company's turnover for 2019 (and if relevant for 2020), and a copy of the full accounts or if full accounts are unavailable, copy bank statements (not excel statements/analysis - unless provided by the bank) showing the company's turnover during the calendar year 2019. 
	* Alternatively, if full accounts or bank statements have not been provided, has the director provided an explanation for the lack records and details of any action (including enforcement) taken to obtain these records?

If the company was incorporated or stated to have commenced trading during 2019/2020: 
	* Is there evidence that the company was actively trading on or before 1 March 2020? Please provide details of the supporting documentation. 
	* Due to a lack of prior trading history, the company would have been able to use estimated turnover anticipated for 2020 in the BBL application. Has the director provided an explanation of how the turnover was estimated and does it appear to have been realistic?

Were any of the BBL funds paid to the director or connected parties? If so, please provide a breakdown of these payments or highlight them in your bank analysis. 
	* What explanation has the director provided for these payments? 
	* Since these payments have been made, has the director or connected party paid any funds into the company? If so, please provide details. 
	* Whether any recovery action is being taken in this matter?

If the company did not meet the criteria for a BBL or overstated the turnover in the BBL application, please provide a copy of the BBL application and agreement. If these are not currently available, please let me know the timeframe of when they will be available.

Since the receipt of the BBL, has the company continued to receive regular income and make regular payments to its creditors? If not, what explanation has the director provided for this apparent lack of trading?
Please provide bank statements and your bank analysis showing all receipts and payments covering the three-month period prior to the receipt of the BBL and until liquidation.
Has the company made any repayments of the BBL? If so, please provide details.
Any other information, which you consider is relevant in this case.

title: Acting as a director whilst disqualified or bankrupt

questions.text: What evidence do you have to demonstrate that the director acted on behalf of the company while being disqualified or bankrupt?

Are there any communications, meeting minutes, or other records that indicate the disqualified/bankrupt director was making decisions or influencing the company's operations? If so, please provide copies of these documents.

Do the bank statements indicate payments made to the disqualified or bankrupt director? If so, please provide a detailed bank statement analysis of these payments, along with copies of the relevant bank statements for the period in question (If available).
Is there a connection between the appointed directors of the company and the disqualified or bankrupt director (e.g. a family relationship)? If so, please provide further details.
Could you confirm the name and company number of the company that is in breach?
Did the company or individual purchase the business, assets, or trading name of the liquidated company? If so, was this purchase communicated to the creditors?
Do any of the statutory exemptions apply?
Was the director informed about the restrictions under Section 216? If so, how was this communicated (e.g., verbally, by letter, email, etc.)?
Is the alleged breach related to the use of a trading style name rather than a registered company name?
Does the successor business operate as a sole trader, partnership, or other entity rather than a limited company?
If the Police are not investigating, which other regulator is currently involved, or which regulator should be investigating this matter?
Have they provided confirmation regarding the nature and outcome of their investigations?
If the investigation is ongoing, do you have a contact email address or telephone number for the person handling the investigation?
Are there any other matters that should be brought to the attention of the Insolvency Service?
